findings.claim: Because strings are stripped before matching, the widened task 3 source scan is satisfied by ANY querySelector(...).addEventListener call, e.g. the task 2 search listener, so a learner attaching per-link click listeners inside renderTrails passes task 3's source scan and behavioral asserts without delegation.
findings.recommendation: Match against a comment-stripped, string-preserving source and require the lookup to name the trail list element.
